question: Which game uses the Elo rating system to assess the skill levels of its players?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Elo rating system is primarily used in the game of **Chess** to assess the skill levels of its players.
 
• Developed by **Arpad Elo**, the system calculates the relative skill levels of players in two-player games such as chess.
 
• Many chess organizations, including the **FIDE (Fédération Internationale des Échecs)**, use the Elo rating system to rank players.
 
• The system has been adapted for use in other games and sports, but it is most commonly associated with chess.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Elo rating system was introduced in 1960 and has since become a standard in the chess world.
 
• A player's Elo rating is updated after each rated game based on the outcome and the ratings of the opponents.
 
• The system is designed to be self-correcting, meaning that a player's rating will stabilize around their true skill level over time.
 
• In addition to chess, the Elo rating system has been adapted for use in other sports and games, including **Go, Scrabble, and video games**.
